visual_identity.description: Atmospheric documentary — Flannan Isles lighthouse mystery, 1900. Dark, desaturated, subtle grain. Prestige-documentary mood with restrained historical texture.
visual_identity.texture: subtle film grain, light dust, restrained gate weave
visual_identity.lighting: directional, low-key, practical light sources (lighthouse lamp, storm shadows)
visual_identity.lens_language: documentary wide shots for isolation, restrained close-ups for tension, slow deliberate movement

motion.still_image_default: slow 1.03x to 1.10x push or lateral parallax
motion.generated_video: subtle physically plausible movement (wind, fog drift)
motion.transition_rule: Use transition only when it supports a change in time, place, idea, or emotional state. Crossfade preferred for story continuity; hard cut for abrupt reveals.

typography.title_family: Segoe UI Bold / serif display (COOPBL for vintage title accent if needed)
typography.body_family: Segoe UI (high-legibility sans serif for lower-thirds/captions)
typography.caption_policy: short, readable, high contrast (white on dark bar), safe margins (60px left, 60px bottom offset from bottom)
typography.caption_background: semi-transparent dark bar (#0a0a0f at 0xbe opacity) with amber accent line (#c8a86e)
avoid: text baked into generated footage images

audio.narration: calm, measured, authoritative male voice (OpenAI onyx or Fish Audio equivalent)
audio.music: synthesized atmospheric drone (pink noise + low/high pass + volume ducking) — clearly labeled placeholder; real cinematic music requires YouTube Audio Library or licensed source
audio.sfx: sparse, motivated (wind, sea, lighthouse mechanism): low volume, not overpowering narration
audio.silence: allowed before important reveals (e.g., before final log entry quote)
audio.mix_rule: Narration always intelligible over music; drone ducked to 0.18 volume; ducking threshold set but verified with simple amix instead of broken sidechaincompress

editorial_rules.visual_literalness: Literal visuals for mechanisms, places, dates, evidence; atmospheric visuals only for mood (storm, fog, isolation).
editorial_rules.historical_reconstruction: No invented details presented as archival fact. Footage from Pexels (verified) used with correct source attribution.
editorial_rules.repetition: No same visual reused within 45 seconds unless intentional and documented (current pipeline reuses 5 clips across 21 beats — editorial limitation flagged).
editorial_rules.continuity: Dark/desaturated palette preserved; subtle grain; consistent lighthouse/storm atmosphere.

pipeline_constraints.hyperframes: Installed v0.8.30; Chrome launches successfully; loader fix needed for video file path resolution (VIDEO_SOURCE_UNRENDERABLE — relative paths resolve incorrectly).
pipeline_constraints.music_source: Pixabay API broken (category=music returns type=photo, no download_url — verified with real Python urllib response). Jamendo excluded (non-commercial only). YouTube Audio Library requires browser automation.
pipeline_constraints.caption_rendering: Sequential PNG overlay chain verified (21 steps, all RC=0). Final video must include captions — visual verification required (drawtext syntax passes but must be inspected via frame extraction).
pipeline_constraints.tts_provider: openai_tts (primary active: onyx, tts-1-hd); fish_audio (primary intended: requires funded OpenRouter account — 402 verified); edge_tts (replaced per user instruction).
pipeline_constraints.review_gate: Timeline must be inspected and approved before render. Timeline v2 rebuilt with actual TTS durations.
